title: The Missing Research Laptop
location: Meridian Innovation Centre, Building B, Room 204
summary: A university-owned research laptop was reported missing from Room 204 after an afternoon project meeting. The room was used by several staff members and students during the day. Available records establish a limited timeline, but do not identify a confirmed offender. The evidence contains both potentially relevant and inconclusive details.

Can the corridor camera still be obtained and reviewed?
Is there evidence that distinguishes accidental relocation from theft?
